meta.title: Tracecart — Get it there.
meta.description: Sourcing and cross-border logistics for landlocked and difficult-to-reach markets. Tell us what needs to move — we'll work out the route.

quoteBar.whatPlaceholder: Describe the product in your own words: what it's for, the brand or model if you know them, how many… or just add a photo or a video.
quoteBar.disclaimer: We look for the product at sellers and manufacturers, then rank it by accuracy and price. A free account is needed to see the results.
quoteBar.submittedBody: Someone from the team will reply to confirm the product and ask where it needs to go.
quoteBar.attach: Add a photo or a video
quoteBar.photoHintPhoto: Photo: PNG, JPEG, WebP · 5 MB max
quoteBar.photoHintVideo: Video: MP4, MOV, WebM · 20 MB, 30 s max
quoteBar.photoInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo of 5 MB or less, or an MP4, MOV or WebM video of 20 MB or less.
quoteBar.needWhat: Describe the product or add a photo.
quoteBar.pickHint: Prices delivered to your door, all included. Buy directly, or choose the closest and send us the request: we check the exact model before we answer.

quoteBar.noneBody: That's fine: send the request and someone will look for it for you.
